A quick glance at Hedge Ohari

 

Hedge Ohari is the finance publication of Hedge Equities Ltd, one of the most reputed financial service providers in Kerala. The magazine which started publication on 1 April 2011 has published over 40,000 copies to date. With over a decade of experience in the domain of Finance, we believe in propagating the concept of Financial Freedom to the grass-root level of society. We accomplish this objective by providing our readers comprehensive knowledge and insight about the various aspects of financial planning and the entire spectrum of investment and wealth creation methods, viz. stock market, mutual funds, real estate, gold, bonds, banking, etc.

The publication which reaches the readers on the 1st of every month aims to enlighten the readers with articles, features, and interviews on diverse topics in the realm of Finance and Business. By incorporating various sections ranging from agriculture to industry, we believe in taking your reading experience to the next level with each of our publications. Our vision is to inculcate a culture of investment by fulfilling the wealth creation objective of our readers. The insights offered to enable the readers to participate in various investment avenues and choose the right investment option based on their preferences.

Hedge Ohari, a must-read for every Malayalam reader who is on the lookout for enhancing their know-how on the Systematic Methods of Financial Planning and Investment is all set with its e-version. The content provided after thorough research and analysis provides valuable insights to both novice and seasoned investors, to enable them to realize their investment objectives strategically.
